messages.text:
"A 2D Metroid game styled after and controlling like the GBA games. It takes place after Metroid Dread. The Galactic Federation has taken Samus hostage, under the guise that with her Metroid DNA she's a danger to the galaxy, but they're actually holding her hostage so they can use her to extract her DNA to attempt to make other Metroid infused super soldiers. Samus escapes containment, but has to make her way out of whatever Galactic Federation research/prison station (or maybe it's a base on a planet). It'll have a good baked in reason as to why she has to collect power ups because obviously the Federation stripped her of all her power ups like the essentially had to do in Fusion

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

This checkout contains **no app or game implementation**—there are no source files, HTML entry point, assets, package manifest, or test configuration. The tracked project files are only the README and GitHub workflow; several local helper files are untracked.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md` — OMGithub project links and boilerplate description; no app-specific documentation.

There is no repository-defined `npm`/`pnpm`/`yarn` command and no test command or test suite. The only apparent start route is `start.sh`, which delegates to the external runtime and cannot be run from the repository alone unless `RUNTIME_DIR` and its scripts are available.

content.text:
Built **METROID: BLACKSITE** in `index.html` as a complete, playable browser game.

Escape the Federation facility, recover three stripped suit systems, activate security consoles to open sector gates, and defeat the prototype at the launch bay. The game includes platforming, enemies, health, checkpoints, boss combat, keyboard and touch controls, and an ending.

**Assumptions:** I made this a self-contained, no-build browser game set in a Federation research station after *Dread*. Start it by opening `index.html` or serving the project on port 3002. The JavaScript syntax check passed; I couldn’t verify the game in a browser because Chromium isn’t installed in the environment.
